prompt: Create an original 120 second bossa nova instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: nylon guitar, shaker, upright bass, electric piano. Style: syncopated guitar chords with gentle Latin groove. Tempo approximately 120 BPM; E minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: An upbeat and lively big band swing piece featuring a prominent brass and saxophone section, supported by a driving rhythm section of piano, upright bass, and drums. The track has a classic, energetic feel.
